name: Biomedical and Translational Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official deadlines conflict: the overview accepts applications through January 16, 2027, but admissions FAQ gives December 31 and referee January 15 without years. Use the earlier December 31 as a planning target and confirm the current deadline and letter-delivery method.

publishedDeadlines.label: Admissions FAQ application deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated and conflicts with dated overview; no year inferred.

publishedDeadlines.label: Overview application window
publishedDeadlines.note: Exact dated window; conflicts with admissions FAQ. Entry term not explicitly named.

english.note: Current admissions page requires official TOEFL scores directly from ETS for non-native English speakers; no score minimum or IELTS alternative established. Page also accepts official MCAT scores without clarifying their relationship to English proficiency; no substitution inferred.

applicationFee.note: One-time waiver for currently participating in, or at least one year of, an eligible program; coordinator letter before submission. Applicants outside listed programs with financial hardship may request a waiver application. International eligibility not explicit; confirm before relying on waiver.

documents: Statement of purpose PDF: maximum 3 double-spaced pages, 11 or 12 point font and 0.5–1 inch margins
Official transcripts; FAQ also permits unofficial copies for initial review
Three recommendation letters from research/academic mentors or supervisors
requirements.note: Accredited bachelor degree in biomedical or related science required. Recommended preparation: one year each of biology, biochemistry, mathematics and physics; two years of general/organic chemistry; chemistry and physics laboratories; significant laboratory research. Separate-letter instructions conflict with FAQ instructions to use portal referee requests; confirm. Three first-year rotations before mentor selection.

funding.note: Overview states enrolled students receive an undated $52,000 per year plus health benefits and support until graduation, with a seven-year time limit. It says tuition is covered by the stipend; no separate tuition-waiver or international guarantee inferred.

timeline.interviews: February interview invitations; campus interview weekend required for admission consideration.
timeline.decisions: March acceptance invitations; page also says enrollment decisions within 10 days of visits.
